---
title: "Curriculum Vitae"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    toc: false
    title-block-banner: false
    title-block-style: plain
---
<p class="cv-lede">
  View my CV below, or
  <a class="cv-inline" href="./assets/cv.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">open in a new tab</a>,
  or
  <a class="cv-inline" href="./assets/cv.pdf" download>download the PDF</a>
  for printing/sharing.
</p>

<div class="cv-box">
  <!-- Desktop/laptop: keep <object> (works well in Chrome/Firefox) -->
  <object data="./assets/cv.pdf" type="application/pdf" class="cv-embed cv-embed--object">
    <p class="cv-fallback">
      Your browser can’t display the PDF inline.
      <a class="cv-inline" href="./assets/cv.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Open the CV PDF</a>.
    </p>
  </object>

  <!-- Mobile (iOS Safari): use <iframe> (object is flaky/black) -->
  <iframe
    src="./assets/cv.pdf"
    class="cv-embed cv-embed--iframe"
    title="CV PDF"
    loading="lazy"
  ></iframe>
</div>

<style>
/* Keep Quarto header spacing reasonable */
.quarto-title-block{
  padding-top: .8rem !important;
  padding-bottom: .3rem !important;
  margin-bottom: .5rem !important;
}

/* Page container */
.cv-box{
  width: min(900px, 92vw);
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}

/* PDF box */
.cv-box{
  border-radius: 16px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(15,23,42,.12);
  background: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(15,23,42,.08);
}

/* Shared embed styling */
.cv-embed{
  width: 100%;
  height: 84vh;
  border: 0 !important;
  display: block;
  background: #fff;
}

/* Default: show the object (desktop) */
.cv-embed--iframe{ display: none; }

/* iOS/mobile: swap to iframe to avoid black/blank PDF rendering */
/* iOS/mobile: swap to iframe + zoom out a bit */
@media (max-width: 750px){
  .cv-embed--object{ display: none; }
  .cv-embed--iframe{ display: block; }

  .cv-embed{
    height: 78vh;           /* a touch taller = more page visible */
    transform: scale(0.92); /* zoom out slightly */
    transform-origin: top center;
    width: 108%;            /* counter the scale so it still fills */
    margin-left: -4%;       /* re-centre after width bump */
  }
}

/* Fallback text */
.cv-fallback{
  padding: 1rem;
  margin: 0;
  color: rgba(31,41,55,.75);
}
</style>
